text_blocks.snippet: Here's a breakdown of treatment approaches:

list.title: Diet:
list.snippet: A healthy diet, especially for fatty liver disease (NAFLD), includes limiting sugar, fructose, and unhealthy fats, and focusing on fruits, vegetables, and whole grains.

list.title: Weight Loss:
list.snippet: For NAFLD, losing weight, even 3-5% of body weight, can significantly improve liver health.
